title: Apply Sustainable Ansible Practices
objective: Apply clear naming, role organization, YAML conventions, local dependencies, concurrency, and configuration practices.

paragraphs: Readable automation uses descriptive play and task names, comments for intent, and related variables near their responsibility. Roles bundle logical configuration, with consumer settings in defaults and internal constants used sparingly in vars.

Structured YAML module arguments are easier to review than dense key=value shorthand. Block scalars preserve multiline values, while folded scalars join wrapped text. Consistent formatting enables reliable linting.

Install pinned Galaxy dependencies inside the project, review community content, tune forks deliberately for larger fleets, and commit ansible.cfg so important behavior is visible and shared. Controllers help govern organization-wide execution.
explanation.rule: Optimize infrastructure code for the next operator who must review, test, and safely rerun it.
